notes: N_tests=50 (35 unchanged from the 2026-09-20 pass + 15 from Batch-1, deduplicated): M6.1 contributes all 4 declared lookback cells -- cross-lookback slope_log_21 correlation checked directly (median per-date Spearman across all 6 lookback pairs: 0.35-0.88), below this study's own 0.89 non-redundancy bar (M11's dist_z@SMA50 precedent) at every pair, kept independent. M6.3 contributes 3 (primary humped_test_sma{20,50,200} only; the excl_large_move and reversal_robustness companion rows are robustness checks on the same hypothesis, not independent tests, already correctly excluded via counted_in_n_tests=False). M7 contributes 4, not 5: the two vol_expansion readings (with/without vol_tercile match) are the same hypothesis tested two ways, an explicit internal-consistency check per this module's own pre-registration, merged into 1; direction_signed, direction_magnitude, direction_conditional_on_trend kept as 3 separate tests (different statistics/populations). M13 contributes all 4 (disjoint VIX/breadth tercile subpopulations of the same underlying above_sma_200 cell -- a restricted-subpopulation test, same treatment M6.2's within-restriction cells received in the original 2026-09-17 pass, not a literal duplicate of M1's own already-counted above_sma_200 cell). RESULT: 5 of 50 cells now reject the null at q=0.10 -- the first time any cell has survived this study's whole-grid FDR correction. Rank 1: slope_magnitude_humped_test_sma50 (M6.3), p=0.00005, more than an order of magnitude under its own rank-1 threshold (0.0020) -- also survives at q=0.05, the only one of the 5 that does. Its very small p-value anchors BH's step-up procedure, sweeping in 4 more cells that individually miss their own rank's threshold but clear the threshold at rank 5 (0.0100): dist_from_52w_low_h126/M18 (p=0.0047), ribbon_direction_magnitude/M7 (p=0.0077), stack_fully_bearish_h21/M2 (p=0.0086), above_sma_20/M1 (p=0.0090) -- all mathematically valid under BH, not an error. Stress-tested against 3 alternative reasonable dedup counts (N=47, 50, 51): identical 5-survivor set and rank-1 p-value in every case -- the finding is not an artifact of this pass's specific dedup judgment calls. TIER CALL (checked individually, none promoted to Tier 2 despite surviving FDR): above_sma_20 fails cost outright (established at M1's original write-up, unrelated to FDR). stack_fully_bearish is capped by DESIGN Sec7.3's explicit, pre-existing survivorship cap on weak/bearish-state buckets. ribbon_direction_magnitude is capped by its own magnitude-vs-signed-return actionability gap (named at its original write-up). dist_from_52w_low_h126 and slope_magnitude_humped_test_sma50 are both newly flagged (this pass, not previously considered) as touching weak/beaten-down-state-adjacent populations plausibly vulnerable to the same delisted-ticker survivorship ceiling already established for M1/M2's capped buckets (a stock near its 52-week low, or in the extreme-negative-slope tail, is exactly the kind of row a pre-2024-delisted bankrupt ticker would occupy immediately before disappearing from this panel) -- extended by analogy, not literally named in DESIGN Sec7.3's enumerated list (M1/M3/M4 only), so treated as an open, not-fully-resolved caveat rather than a hard pre-existing cap. slope_magnitude_humped_test_sma50's case is partially mitigated by its own 'roughly symmetric' tail shape (the rising, non-weak-state tail independently contributes a similar-sized share per its own shape_table numbers) but no direct rising-only-vs-falling-only decomposition has been run to fully resolve this, unlike the reversal confound, which was directly tested this session and resolved in this cell's favor. Both also remain capped by the pre-existing holdout/universe-tier infrastructure gap common to every Tier-3 cell in this study. Net effect: the 'zero survivors' statistical headline no longer holds, but the study's actionable conclusion is unchanged -- no cell reaches Tier 2.
